misconceptions.believed: A skipTest guarding the naive-solution test would only fire if the level's contract changed later
misconceptions.revealed_by: It fired on the first run because the fixture returned the wrong dict shape; the test written because of M1 reported as a green skip
misconceptions.corrected_to: The fixture matches the level and the test asserts its precondition
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: A test that skips on its own precondition can hide exactly the thing it exists for; assert the precondition.

misconceptions.believed: Headless Chromium at the phone's viewport and pixel ratio previews the app faithfully
misconceptions.revealed_by: On the Pixel the ASCII logo overflowed; DevTools showed the block glyph at 0.708 em and the ExtraBold face never requested, because <pre> takes the platform monospace from the UA stylesheet
misconceptions.corrected_to: pre and textarea inherit the bundled font; every grid is JetBrains Mono on every platform
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: Emulating a viewport emulates the viewport, not the fonts; look at the real device before calling a character grid done.

misconceptions.believed: Returning the whole payload from Pyodide's stdin callback delivers the whole line
misconceptions.revealed_by: JSONDecodeError at char 8190 on the first production-sized payload
misconceptions.corrected_to: The byte-level read(buffer) stdin, drained like a pipe
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: Probe a new transport with a production-sized payload, not a toy one.

decisions.decision: Run the real engine on phones and in browsers via Pyodide, bundled in those builds only (user-approved N1 exception)
decisions.rationale: Keeps one engine: scores come from scoring.py, not a copy; the Python package stays dependency-free

decisions.decision: An async Service with an injected executor, not synchronous run_code inside Pyodide
alternatives: Block the engine worker on a sandbox with SharedArrayBuffer and Atomics
decisions.rationale: Avoids requiring cross-origin isolation on static hosts; the executor seam makes the layer testable with real subprocesses

decisions.decision: Boss steps run free and the page replays them at the CLI's pace
alternatives: Live stepping over a blocking stdin with SharedArrayBuffer
decisions.rationale: Same visible behaviour and scoring: pause on the raising line, strategy-A divergence, heal on the failing code, animation off the clock

decisions.decision: Hand-built Android shell with SDK tools only, no INTERNET permission, no cloud backup
decisions.rationale: Nothing downloaded at build time, nothing third-party in the APK but Pyodide, and a privacy promise the OS enforces

decisions.decision: The phone's reset also deletes saved runs
alternatives: Match vibecoder reset, which removes only the profile
decisions.rationale: A run artifact is the player's code and a phone offers no terminal to find it afterwards

decisions.decision: A boss attempt runs the watched step and the full verdict concurrently
decisions.rationale: The CLI waits because its child is blocked on a person; here neither waits on anyone
